name: qreflector_condition_check_v2_after_evidence
reason_format: Precondition check: ... Postcondition check: ... Task progress: ...
changes: Use AFTER as primary outcome evidence and BEFORE as the transition baseline; do not infer an action effect from a desirable AFTER state alone.
Ground expected effects in the current action type, target and supplied value, excluding later steps.
Treat generated prerequisites as fallible hypotheses; reconcile conflicting assumptions with direct outcome evidence rather than adding an automatic veto.
Check exact target fields and values and retain correct-execution AND task-progress semantics.

Define precondition as requirements on the BEFORE state and postcondition as the expected result of correct action execution, both without using AFTER; AFTER is used only for checking and the verdict.
limitations: Prompt instructions do not guarantee an internal reasoning order.
The model can see AFTER while generating conditions; there is no technical visibility mask.
Formal output-schema constraints and programmatic verdict checks are not added by this text file.
evaluation_note: This candidate incorporates qualitative observations from the existing test analysis. It is not a blind test-independent prompt. Use validation for subsequent comparisons and report any later test comparison as exploratory; no performance gain is established.
activation: Saved as an independent candidate only. No dataset, training/evaluation job, or default prompt reference changed.
